question: How does the original decide AI behaviour in skirmish (build order, attack timing)?
probes: data/scripts/lib/ai.script and data/scripts/units/global.inc/progresswarai.inc are compiled .aix (packed); progreseconomicai.inc 231KB is also .aix.
resolution: The original skirmish AI lives in compiled .aix files (progreseconomicai.inc, progresswarai.inc) that are packed/binary and not readable here. The port uses an approximation that gathers, builds mines/barracks/stable, trains peasants and military, defends and attacks in waves; exact build order and attack timing remain estimated.
